root_cause.text: The loop in `ethosu_gem_cmdstream_copy_and_validate()` increments the index `i` a second time for 64-bit commands without re-checking the loop bound, allowing an out-of-bounds write past the DMA-allocated buffer when `i` reaches `size/4`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "When i == size/4 - 1 on entry to an iteration and bit 14 of cmds[0] is set, bocmds[size/4-1] is written in bounds, i is then incremented to size/4, and bocmds[size/4] writes four bytes past the end of the allocation." The patch fix adds a bounds check `if (i >= size / 4) return -EINVAL;` after the second increment to prevent the out-of-bounds write.
